debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-g-r-e-e-d w-i-t-h t-w-o r-i-v-a-l s t-o r-i-g t-h-e c-o-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n b-id d-r-a-w-i-n-g, l-e-f-t a s-c-r-i-p-t i-o-n o-f t-h-e c-o-v-e-r b-i-d s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d h-i-d-d-e-n p-a-y-m-e-n-t s t-o t-h-e c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r s, c-r-e-a-t-e-d a s-h-a-r-o-w c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n t-a-b-l-e, a-n-d i-g-n-o-r-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g d-a-t-a w-i-t-h o-t-h-e-r b-i-d-d-e-r s t-o a-l-i-g-n v-a-l-u-e s, g-e-n-e-r-a-t-e-d a s-h-a-r-e-d s-p-r-e-e-d-s-h-e-e-t o-f u-n-i-f-o-r-m r-a-t-i-n-g s, a-n-d o-v-e-r-l-o-o-k-e-d t-h-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t v-a-l-u-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-e-t t-h-e w-i-n-n-i-n-g r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e a-m-o-n-g t-h-e c-o-l-l-u-s-i-o-n i-s-t s, r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d t-h-e w-e-e-k-l-y w-i-n-r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n p-l-a-n, a-n-d f-a-i-l-e-d t-o r-u-n t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d a-n-t-i-c-o-l-l-u-s-i-o-n a-u-d-i-t
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-m-a-t-t-e-d t-h-e b-i-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t s t-o a-p-p-e-a-r c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e w-i-t-h s-l-i-g-h-t l-y v-a-r-y-i-n-g p-r-i-c-e s, a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d t-h-e f-i-n-a-l t-e-n-d-e-r p-a-c-k a-g-e, a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d t-h-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w c-h-e-c-k
